name: problogger_jobs-jobs-mcp
description: ProBlogger Job Board (jobs): search. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search
tools.description: ProBlogger Job Board RSS (WPJobBoard, RSS 2.0) of active postings. query and location are the board's search parameters carried into the feed (checked 2026-09-25: ?query=writer and ?location=remote narrow it). The feed is one list, so page and limit are not sent (ignore next_page). category (job type and category) stays in raw. id is the posting link.
